name: AMBC Round 1 Short Track
summary: Short laps and quick races, so it's easy to watch. Round 1 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: AMBC Round 2 Short Track
summary: Short laps and quick races, so it's easy to watch. Round 2 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: First Descent Series Round 1
summary: Inside Line's beginner downhill series, raced on easier blue trails. A great first downhill race.

name: Downduro (Enduro + Downhill State Round 1)
organiser: Gravity Enduro SA and Inside Line MTB Club
summary: A joint race that counts for the enduro state series, the downhill state series and the Gravity Girls series.

name: AMBC Round 4 O'Halloran Hill Twilight
summary: A long cross-country race that runs into the evening. Round 4 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: First Descent Series Round 2
summary: Inside Line's beginner downhill series on an easier track.

name: Downhill National Series (Willunga)
summary: Australia's best downhill riders race at Willunga. It also counts as SA State Round 2, and it's great to watch even if you're not racing.

name: School Sport SA Mountain Bike Team Championship
venue: Sturt Gorge Recreation Park, Craigburn Farm
summary: Teams of 2 to 4 students ride timed laps against other SA schools. Years 7 to 12 race on the Thursday and Years 5 and 6 on the Friday. Ask your school's sport teacher.

name: Gravity Enduro SA Round 2
summary: Round 2 of the state enduro series.

name: AMBC Round 5 Craigburn Farm
summary: A long-distance cross-country race. Round 5 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: Downhill State Series Round 3
summary: Round 3 of the SA downhill state series. Camping is available.

name: Gravity Enduro SA Round 3
summary: Round 3 of the state enduro series.

name: AMBC Round 6 Kinchina 8 Hour
summary: An 8 hour race that you can ride solo or as a team. Round 6 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: First Descent Series Round 4
summary: Inside Line's beginner downhill series on an easier blue trail.

name: Gravity Enduro SA Round 4
summary: Round 4 of the state enduro series.

name: Downhill State Series Round 4
summary: Round 4 of the SA downhill state series.

name: Downhill State Series Round 5
summary: Round 5 of the SA downhill state series.

name: AMBC Round 7 Eagle 2 Hour
summary: A 2 hour race that you can ride solo or as a team. Round 7 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: First Descent Series Round 5
summary: The last round of Inside Line's beginner downhill series.

name: Gravity Enduro SA State Championships
licence: AusCycling off-road membership, day licence or trial licence
summary: The state enduro championship. There's a Novice category for first-timers and categories for kids as young as under 9.

name: SA Downhill Championships
summary: The state downhill championship and the last round of the state series.

name: AMBC Round 8 Cross-Country
summary: Round 8 of the Adelaide MTB Club series.

name: Chainless Charity Champs
summary: A fun downhill race with no chains on the bikes. It raises money for charity.

name: AMBC Cross-Country Club Championships
summary: The club's cross-country championship, with categories from Little Shredders (under 9) up to Masters. Racing starts at 8:30am. It's on private property, so drive slowly on Oval Road.

name: AMBC Juniors Day
venue: Fox Creek MTB Park (upper car park)
summary: A free day of coaching and riding for junior riders of all abilities, from 10am to 4pm. Spots are limited and club members get first pick. Entries close Wednesday 11 November.

name: Gravity Girls SA Come & Try Ride
venue: Fox Creek Bike Park, Cudlee Creek
summary: A free, relaxed group ride for women and girls who can ride green singletrack, from 11am to 12:30pm. Riders under 14 need an adult with them.

name: MTB National Championships
summary: Australia's national mountain bike championships. A good one for a group trip.

name: Enduro National Championships
summary: Australia's national enduro championships at Derby.

name: Marathon National Championships
summary: Australia's national marathon championships.
